phase3_findings.description: README.md's Database URLs section says any URL scheme other than the listed mysql+pymysql:// and mysql:// fails at config load, but the validator accepts every mysql+<driver>:// URL (for example mysql+mysqldb://, mysql+mysqlconnector://).
docs/external/getting-started.md says any URL scheme other than the listed mysql+pymysql:// and mysql:// fails at config load, but the validator accepts every mysql+<driver>:// URL.
The supported-scheme rule is stated in four places that disagree; factory, preflight and sqlglot_dialect_for_url still accept a bare mysql prefix such as mysqlx:// when config validation is skipped.
DatabaseConfig.dialect returns the scheme's raw case and any sqlite-prefixed text, leaving normalization to callers.
claude-desktop install --dry-run returns a clean plan for a database URL the new scheme check refuses, because the dry run returns before validate_toml.
The ported cursor-allocation test fails at the read-only setup cursor, so a query-cursor allocation failure in MySQLRunner is never tested.
The new mysql row in test_call_after_nested_comment_markers_is_checked is refused by the nested-comment check before any function lookup, duplicating existing rows.
The MySQL row says the URL requires a database name, but build_sql_runner checks only hostname and username.
